current_universe: stocks with eligible=true on the latest available feature date
historical_entry_universe: all historically eligible sessions for each current-universe stock
reason_monthly_leadership_gate_is_false: The stock-focus screener itself selects the 15 names. Requiring the existing monthly Top-15 leadership gate would make the screen circular and would not reproduce the requested per-stock historical F2.2 evaluation.
methodology_reference: Original mean-reversion stock screener structure: standalone per-stock backtest -> Sharpe/CAGR/MaxDD/Trades -> Calmar -> hard filters -> 0-1 min-max normalization -> 30/30/30/10 composite ranking.
strategy_rules: Frozen F2.2 entry filters, exit rules, next-security-session-close entry execution, same-close exits, cooldown, and transaction costs are loaded from config.yaml without modification. Production F2.2 portfolio sizing is intentionally NOT used by this standalone stock-ranking tool.

capital_model.note: $2,000 is 40% of the independent $5,000 standalone account. Fixed dollar notional is used on every trade so ranking is not distorted by F2.2 production's 12.5% portfolio weight or by whole-share price rounding.

terminal_rule: Reject and rerun any unresolved final position entry; never score a forced terminal liquidation.

score.method: 0-1 min-max normalization among stocks passing hard filters, matching the original screener methodology

non_goals: No portfolio-level allocation across the Top 15
No change to the frozen F2.2 production engine or config

single_trade_concentration.basis: largest positive completed-trade net P&L in USD divided by total completed-trade net P&L in USD at the end of the standalone backtest
single_trade_concentration.denominator_requirement: total completed-trade net P&L must be positive
single_trade_concentration.action: exclude exactly that one largest positive completed trade from ranking metrics and recompute the stock once
single_trade_concentration.ranking_effect: the excluded trade is neutralized from the daily ranking equity path; all other trade chronology and fixed-$2,000 sizing remain unchanged
single_trade_concentration.note: This is a stock-selection robustness adjustment only. It does not alter F2.2 production, Pine signals, or live exits.
